evaluator: G1 Factory served by `simulators/g1_arena/env_server.py`, one scene at a time, GPU physics, native camera frame, stochastic steering actor, success when the task's success term fires within 1000 simulator steps (20 s, G1 Factory's episode length). The base checkpoint `nvidia/G1-Factory-GR00T-1.7` and the released steering checkpoint are scored on the same 300 held-out episodes (seeds 5050–5199 and 6000–6149). Peak is the checkpoint chosen by its in-training evaluation. This differs from G1 Factory's evaluation, which reports 42% for the base checkpoint on PushButton
